name: @nessgate/resolver
description: Open, neutral universal resolver for the agentic web: give it a domain and get one normalized answer with the machine-readable resources it publishes across ARD (well-known, rel=ard, robots Agentmap), A2A, llms.txt, API catalogs, OpenAPI, ORD, host-meta, Agent Network Protocol, Universal Commerce Protocol, AID (TXT v=aid1), and GB/Z 185.4 agent descriptions. Adapter architecture; dependency-free; fetches the domain directly. Optional Node-only GB/Z 185.5 gateway discovery (bring-your-own auth).
author: Adam Dean
